label: Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and is LIVING_2 is LIVING_1
paraphrase: Open sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever is in potency in no respect (pure act) and whose life is present at some time of the duration frame (LIVING_2, LivesSomeTime) lives in the timeless sense (LIVING_1, the primitive Primitives.Lives of the Dei Filius attributes). Restricted to pure act: for a being in potency in some respect, life at one time need not be its life without a time index, since it may begin or cease; for a pure act, a beginning or end of life would be a change, which needs potency (q.9 a.1; compare STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY). That is its motivation, not a derivation: LIVING_1 stays primitive. Strictly weaker than the unrestricted bridge LifeAtSomeTimeIsLiving (Control.Controls part 4), which no argument uses. It does not identify the two senses.
